answer: Make each identity pay a burnable stake that fades like pigment left in the sun: to join, an agent locks a small deposit that is slashed if unrelated peers catch it attesting lies. Newcomers start on a flat mesa of low trust and only climb as their work is verified over weeks by strangers, not friends. A sybil swarm can fake numbers, but every fake pays its own stake, and one bad attestation sends a ripple through its whole cluster, slashing the group together. Attack cost scales with every fake identity, while honest history is the only cheap path upward.
